messages:
jade: Hey team 44 I'm Jade, starting today as a Product Designer. Quick setup/checklist Qs: I don't see the Figma org invite yet and Notion shows a 403 for /Product. Also who should I ping for a design system walkthrough and to be added to the weekly critique?

marco: welcome @jade :tada: Im design-ops. I pushed a Figma invite to your work email at 09:05 (ticket #IT-2298). Check spam and 'Social' tab. If nothing, DM me your exact email and I'll re-send an SSO invite. The design system is in Figma file 'Redwood DS' + tokens are also in figma tokens plugin.

lena: hi @jade, congrats! Roadmap and PRD templates are in Notion > Product. I'm adding you to Notion now. If you still see 403 it's usually an SSO group issue  ping @design-ops and @hr-bot for access.

hr-bot: :wave: Welcome package sent. Onboarding checklist: 1) confirm laptop receipt (IT will DM), 2) accept Figma invite, 3) join #product-design and weekly critique (Weds 10am).

jade: thanks, I just tried the Figma link and it errors with "You need permission to view this file." Notion still 403 too.

design-ops: Re-sent SSO invite to jade@redwood.com. If you see an error like `SSO: user_not_in_group`, reply here. Also scheduled a short DS walkthrough with @marco at 4pm today; invite sent.

marco: For research ops: templates (consent, screener, discussion guide) are in Drive > UX > Templates. We also keep short research playbooks in Notion > Product > Research Playbook — I'll add you once Notion access is cleared. If you want to shadow, we have a moderated session tomorrow 11am, DM me and I'll add you as observer.

lena: added you to the roadmap page and gave comment access. If you want the product context doc, search Notion for "Quarterly Priorities" or ping me and I'll drop a direct link.

jade: Got Figma access now, I can see Redwood DS 4 thanks! Notion still 403 but I can work in Figma for now. Appreciate the walkthrough invite at 4pm.

design-ops: Notion group sync is still pending (IT ticket IT-2298). ETA EOD. Meanwhile I uploaded a zip of starter assets to Drive and dropped link in DMs.

marco: also looping @lena for a short intro to the roadmap in our 1:1 next week. Welcome again, and feel free to post any quick questions in #product-design or here.
